title: manifest
description: What one rendered platform variant is, for whom, and where it goes: engine/out/<channel>/<date>/<video id>/<platform>/<channel>-<platform>-<date>-<id>.manifest.json. Written last by engine/scripts/make.mjs; QA fills in qa_status. QA, approval and dispatch trust nothing the manifest does not say, and refuse a variant whose manifest disagrees with its folder, channel.json or style preset.

date.description: the video's slot date (its recipe), the date folder

style_version.description: the style preset (styles/<id>.json) the variant was rendered from

voice.description: the local voice used (engine/voice/speed), or null for a silent render

cta_text.description: the closing card's CTA for this platform (the preset's, without *accent* marks)

cta_say.description: the spoken CTA line on the closing card

end_card_handle.description: the account named on the end card (the preset's end_card.handle), or null when it names none

destination.description: this platform's publisher in channel.json at render time; dispatch refuses if it changed since

handle.description: @handle, or pending_... while the username is not claimed (QA holds the variant, except Facebook with a page_id)

video_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the video file; QA checks the file still is it, approval records it, dispatch sends only it
